task: wave-3 t4 — codegraph F-B8-1 degradation + O-1 apply-time root

design.F-B8-1: launcher-side, per the t1 decision record (evidence/wave3/registry-redesign/t1-decision-record.txt §A4). dist/serve.js is untouched: it is a sha-pinned prebuilt behind the blocking vendor gate, so a marked delta there would either fail the gate or turn it into a self-attestation. The launcher catches the throw, prints it to stderr, pins MPD_CODEGRAPH_BIN to the path-looking sentinel /nonexistent/mpd-codegraph-unavailable and retries once; the adopted resolver then takes source:'env' and provisionMissingCodegraph returns null at its first guard -> runUnavailableMcp -> 0 tools, exit 0. A retry happens only while process.stdout.bytesWritten === 0 (the MCP stream owns stdout).
design.O-1: packages/mpd-codegraph-plugin/src/index.ts resolves through the shared adapter's workspace plane now: (1) MPD_CODEGRAPH_PROJECT_CWD / MPD_DSH_CODEGRAPH_PROJECT_CWD override, (2) dsh.workspaceRoot(exec) — the call-time /mpd-codegraph handler passes the invocation, the exec-less apply-time call resolves DSH_WORKSPACE_ROOT -> process.cwd(), (3) process.cwd() as the adapter's own last tier. The bare `|| process.cwd()` chain is gone.
design.adjacent_fix: The /mpd-codegraph handler returned {success, error} — dsh-commands' normalizeResult requires a CommandResult {kind} and rejects anything else, so the call-time path could never succeed. It now returns {kind:'success'|'error', text} and re-resolves the root per invocation. This was necessary to prove the call-time O-1 behaviour.

acceptance.criterion: F-B8-1: with codegraph unresolvable AND $HOME/.mpd unwritable the MCP child degrades instead of dying uncaught
acceptance.evidence: degrade-launcher.mjs (real MCP stdio child, measured against the genuinely read-only /root/.mpd): RED (pre-fix bytes) exit 1, 0 stdout bytes, uncaught `Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, mkdir '/root/.mpd/codegraph'` with the stack acquireLock -> ensureCodegraphProvisioned -> provisionMissingCodegraph -> runCodegraphServe -> launcher (red-launcher.stderr.txt); GREEN exit 0, initialize + tools/list answered with 0 tools, stderr carries the original error under '[mpd-mcp-codegraph] unavailable fallback:' plus 'CodeGraph MCP skipped' (green-launcher.stderr.txt, green-launcher.stdout.jsonl). 6/6 checks pass.

acceptance.evidence: bun test packages/mpd-codegraph-plugin -> 7 pass / 0 fail (it matched no test file before this change: exit 1 'did not match any test files'); bun test packages -> 366 pass / 0 fail; bun run typecheck -> exit 0; both mount boots -> ok=true on two consecutive runs, 0 apply-crash signatures, no uncaught child error. A dsh RESTART is required: the changed code is the plugin's committed dist/index.js (loaded at plugin mount) and the MCP launcher (spawned by the mcp-codegraph row at boot). A running dsh keeps the previously loaded plugin code and the already-spawned MCP child; the /mpd-codegraph handler re-resolves its root per call but still runs the loaded code.

The /mpd-codegraph call-time root is proven at the handler level with the harness CommandInvocation shape ({agent:{session:{header:{cwd}}}); no live web session was driven for this task.
